notes.integration: Components only; application code is not included.
notes.overlays: Claude adds all Ukrainian text, numbers, hero portraits, gold, XP, loot, feedback states, and icons programmatically.

assets.purpose: Opaque clean warm painted victory-cellar scene behind the scenario-end results UI; the central Lantern-Obereg, amber lanterns, wood, stone, barrels, goose pennants, and empty floor remain. Contains no UI, text, heroes, portraits, rewards, panels, buttons, numbers, or icons.

2×2 sheet of fully structured opaque hero-result card bodies on a transparent canvas: Warden #3B6FB6 top-left, Wind Archer #2FA36B top-right, Herbalist #E0B040 bottom-left, Rogue #7E4FC4 bottom-right. Each card has an empty alpha portrait aperture, name/stat/objective sections, and no baked portrait, text, number, or gameplay icon.

Wide opaque blue-slate/gold loot panel on a transparent canvas, with three empty item-slot sections and one empty destination section separated by a fine divider. No baked title, loot, text, number, icon, or arrow.

2×2 sheet of filled empty button bases on a transparent canvas: wide emerald-green primary action top row, then cyan-blue, blue-slate/gold, and warm-red compact feedback buttons. No baked label, text, number, or icon.
